title: eleocharis tenuis var. atrata
intro: Eleocharis tenuis var. atrata, commonly known as black spike-rush, is a type of plant that belongs to the family Cyperaceae. It is a medicinal plant that has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, with reported health benefits including anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antifungal properties, which may help to reduce swelling, prevent infections, and promote wound healing. The therapeutic actions of black spike-rush include analgesic, antipyretic, and anti-inflammatory effects, which may help to relieve pain, reduce fever, and alleviate inflammation. The bioactive constituents of black spike-rush include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
